1.web: If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
1.asv: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,

2.web: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;
2.asv: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;

3.web: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;
3.asv: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us:

4.web: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;
4.asv: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;

5.web: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
5.asv: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

6.web: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
6.asv: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

7.web: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
7.asv: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

8.web: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
8.asv: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
